name: scrapbro
description: Saves web pages to local disk and manages them in the browser sidebar, compatible with ScrapBook/ScrapBee data. Builds for Chromium and Firefox.

scripts.lint:firefox: node build.mjs firefox && npx --yes web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.run:firefox: node build.mjs firefox && npx --yes web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.sign:firefox: node build.mjs firefox && npx --yes web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --channel unlisted
